tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Read current public plans, prices, currency, limits, models and source URLs for a language edition.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Read the public feature comparison of two or three Semly plans in the requested language.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search published pages, functions, integrations, glossary entries and article titles/excerpts in a language edition.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read Markdown for a public Semly page or published article. Use its relative public path from search results. The path selects its language. External URLs, private APIs and drafts are rejected.
